answer: Mechanism: knoll-indexed anchor pricing. Each agent maintains an anchor identity whose knoll score equals independent compute/bandwidth evidence. Spawning concurrent identities that share an anchor or fingerprint routes their traffic through a copper meter with marginal price p_k = p0·2^(k/κ). The k-th live alias pays double the prior tier; revenue funds audits, not gate. A sybil farm of N correlated agents pays geometric sum p0(2^(N/κ)-1), making mass aliases exponentially costly while honest agents stay near p0.
